normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize Google Test JSON output by replacing transient time, timestamp, and stack trace values with wildcards
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in test output JSON by replacing duration strings like 1.23s with asterisks
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in test output JSON by replacing ISO 8601 timestamps with asterisks
normalize_failure_messages: normalize failure messages in test output by masking file line numbers and stack traces
normalize_nested_json_objects: recursively normalize nested dicts and lists in Google Test JSON output to remove transient data
